recognize_zh: 兩格血片中有許多小而深染、失去中央淡染區的球形紅血球（spherocytes），夾雜較大偏藍的多染性紅血球；箭頭所指細胞一側有凹口、形如鉗子或蘑菇（pincer cell），是 band 3 缺乏型遺傳性球形紅血球症的線索。
features: Numerous small, dense, round red cells lacking central pallor (spherocytes/microspherocytes)
Occasional pincer (mushroom-shaped) red cells with a single notch or cleft on one side (arrows)
Larger, slightly bluish-gray polychromatophilic red cells indicating reticulocytosis
Marked anisocytosis with admixed normal discocytes showing central pallor
Scattered platelets; no schistocytes, sickle cells or target cells prominent
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (two fields, Leishman stain) shows marked anisocytosis with a population of small, dense spherocytes lacking central pallor admixed with larger polychromatophilic red cells. Scattered red cells show a single notch-like indentation producing a pincer or mushroom shape (arrows). Schistocytes, sickle cells and prominent target cells are not seen. Findings are consistent with a hemolytic process with spherocytes and pincer cells; in the setting of lifelong jaundice, splenomegaly and a positive family history, they are suggestive of hereditary spherocytosis, particularly the band 3-deficient type.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes look identical, so a positive IgG direct antiglobulin test and absence of pincer cells or family history favor AIHA.
MAHA shows true schistocytes (helmet cells, triangles, fragments) with thrombocytopenia rather than intact cells with a single notch.

ddx.dx: Oxidative hemolysis (G6PD deficiency) with bite cells
ddx.vs: Bite cells have a bitten-out rim with blister cells and Heinz bodies on supravital stain, and G6PD activity is low, which was normal here.

ddx.dx: Southeast Asian ovalocytosis or hereditary elliptocytosis
ddx.vs: These show stomatocytic ovalocytes or elliptocytes rather than round spherocytes, and they are confirmed by EMA binding and membrane gene testing.
